body:
Sorry, I forgot to address these comments.

(1) That's a good idea to throw if `VERSION` is not defined when releasing, but not as-is in the Rollup build script because it means that we wouldn't be able to build locally.

(2) Historically we had this "UNRELEASED" tag to be able to see where the build came from, and to tag it as not official.

Does Ship.js inject an environment variable somewhere? CircleCI (and all CIs) [inject `CI=true`](https://circleci.com/docs/2.0/env-vars/#built-in-environment-variables) to give context to scripts. We could imagine injecting `RELEASE=true`in Ship.js when the job is eligible to releasing (the commit name matches), and throw in the Rollup script if `RELEASE=true` *and* `VERSION` is `undefined`.
